uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1084-4279-6578.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-6578.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-6578.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

529-4186-7060-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4050-5254-6774.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
4050-5254-6774.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Repeat.

141-4050-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-4050-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

215-1879-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1768-5641-7306.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

206-3259-7686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
206-3259-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1170-3363-5078-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
1170-3363-5078-7693.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

1799-5231-5359-7654.description:
Activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and the Gnomes, adding {4}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2074-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2074-5231-6972.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

5342-7450.description: Cast Pox Plague by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}, causing you to lose half your life, and each player to discard half their hand and sacrifice half their permanents, rounded down. Each opponent will lose half their life, rounded down, and then doubled due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz.
5342-7450.notes: Each opponent with an odd life total will have 1 life remaining. Each opponent with an even life total will have 0 life and lose the game.

774-4543-4826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}.
774-4543-4826.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trench Behemoth twice by returning two lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting both lands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

1651-4365-7318.description:
Activate Coin of Mastery by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens due to Mondrak.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Coin of Mastery.
Repeat.

104-3490-4476-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4476-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

850-1978-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
850-1978-3263.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Overgrown Battlement.
Repeat

413-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 5.

1884-2060-2919-3525.description:
Activate Silent Attendant by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Silent Attendant.
Repeat.

3372-4050-4927-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-4927-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

654-1231-2511-6644.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2713-4617-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Soulbright Flamekin.
Activate the Soulbright Flamekin token three times by paying {3}, adding eight {R} when the third ability resolves.
Repeat.

2313-4120-4968.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2313-4120-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
2313-4120-4968.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2736-2921-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2736-2921-5434-5555.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1378-2724-4006.notablePrerequisites: Mirage Phalanx is paired with Wormfang Manta.
1378-2724-4006.description:
At tbe beginning of your combat phase, Mirage Phalanx and Wormfang Manta trigger.
Resolve the Mirage Phalanx trigger, creating a token copy of it with haste and that doesn't have soulbond.
Resolve the Wormfang Manta trigger, creating a token copy of it with haste.
The Wormfang Manta token's first ability does not trigger due to Hushbringer.
At the end of your combat phase, the Mirage Phalanx and Wormfang Manta tokens trigger, exiling themselves.
The Wormfang Manta token's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

578-1651-3263-3888.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three artifact cards in hand.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
578-1651-3263-3888.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, causing you to reveal three artifact cards from your hand, and adding at least {6}.
Activate Olivia's Attendants twice by paying {6}, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Olivia's Attendants triggers twice, creating two Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Blood tokens, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.
If you have four or more artifact cards in your hand, this combo nets infinite mana.

796-3199-3209.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least two untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
796-3199-3209.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping a green creature and any other creature you control.
Poppet Stitcher's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve Sprout Swarm, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

539-3263-4241-4552.description:
Acitvate Karn by paying {0} due to Blossoming Tortoise, causing a land an opponent controls to become a 0/0 artifact creature.
The land dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a land enters the battlefield under an opponent's control, and you may repeat this for any permanents opponents control with mana value equal to zero.

3199-3209-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control an untapped green creature.
3199-3209-5195.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {1} and tapping a green creature you control.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Sprout Swarm, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Glen Elendra Archmage

2034-2831-3908.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Spark Double, adding {C}{C}.
When Spark Double dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
As Spark Double enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Glen Elendra Archmage with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

708-2459-2500-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh.
Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror trigger, drawing you two cards.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Return Rograkh to the command zone.
Cast Rograkh for {0}.
Repeat.

1085-4053-5256.description:
Cast Chronozoa by paying {3}{U}. It will enter without a time counter on it due to Solemnity.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Chronozoa.
When Chronozoa dies, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself that also enter with no time counters on them due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2 using a token copy of Chronozoa instead.

2034-2843-3175.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.
